jobs.title: Software Engineer (Python)
jobs.description:
About The Company

Checkr is a leading technology company dedicated to transforming the background check industry through innovative solutions and cutting-edge technology. Established with the mission to create a fairer and more efficient hiring process, Checkr leverages artificial intelligence and machine learning to deliver accurate, fast, and compliant background screening services. Our platform is trusted by thousands of organizations across various industries, including technology, finance, healthcare, and retail, to make informed hiring decisions while maintaining the highest standards of privacy and security. At Checkr, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that encourages continuous learning, innovation, and growth.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Data Analyst to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for analyzing large datasets to identify trends, develop insights, and support strategic decision-making across the organization. You will work closely with cross-functional teams including product, engineering, and compliance to optimize processes, improve data quality, and enhance our platform's capabilities. The ideal candidate will have a strong analytical mindset, proficiency in data visualization tools, and a passion for leveraging data to solve complex business challenges. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to a fast-paced, innovative company that is redefining the background screening industry.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field.
Proven experience as a Data Analyst or similar role, preferably within a technology or SaaS environment.
Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, R, or other data analysis tools.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen eye for detail.
Ability to communicate complex data insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Knowledge of data privacy standards and compliance regulations is a plus.

Responsibilities

Collect, clean, and analyze large datasets to uncover meaningful insights and trends.
Develop and maintain dashboards and reports to monitor key performance indicators.
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to identify data needs and implement solutions.
Support data-driven decision-making processes by providing actionable recommendations.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across various platforms.
Contribute to the ongoing improvement of data collection and analysis methodologies.
Assist in the development of predictive models and advanced analytics initiatives.
Stay updated on industry best practices and emerging data analysis tools and techniques.

Benefits

Checkr offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and professional growth of our employees. This includes competitive salary packages, health insurance plans, dental and vision coverage, and retirement savings options. We also provide generous paid time off, flexible work arrangements, and opportunities for continuous learning through training and development programs. Employees have access to wellness programs, employee assistance programs, and a collaborative work environment that values diversity and inclusion. At Checkr, we believe in recognizing and rewarding talent and fostering a culture of innovation and excellence.

Equal Opportunity

Checkr is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We celebrate diversity and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute their best. Our commitment to diversity and inclusion is fundamental to our success and innovation as a company.

jobs.description:
About Us:

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Software Engineer, SEM Infrastructure to join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.

Responsibilities:

Build and maintain API integrations with major advertising platforms (Google Ads, Bing Ads) for automated campaign management and creative asset synchronization.
Develop scalable backend services to handle automated keyword management, categorization, and large-scale ad creation (including image handling).
Design and maintain infrastructure for dynamic landing page rendering and real-time personalization at scale.
Design data architectures that process large volumes of traffic data, enabling accurate A/B testing and performance tracking for various creative combinations.
Optimize system performance to support real-time bid changes and high-concurrency requests.
Work closely with the algorithm team to deploy and serve machine learning, large language models, and computer vision models in production.

Job Requirements:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
2+ years of software engineering experience, preferably building large-scale backend systems or data pipelines.
Strong proficiency in at least one backend programming language (e.g., Java, C++, Go, or Python).
Solid understanding of system design, distributed systems, and database architecture (SQL and NoSQL).
Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities and a focus on code quality.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively within a cross-functional team.

Preferred skills and qualifications:
Experience with big data frameworks (e.g., Apache Spark, Hive, Hadoop, Flink).
Previous experience in AdTech, computational advertising, or integrating with Google Ads/Bing Ads APIs.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).

Compensation and Benefits

Our compensation structure is designed to align with the cost of labor in various geographic markets across the US. The total salary for this position ranges from $100,000 to $300,000 annually, based on job-related factors such as skills, experience, qualifications, competencies and location.

In addition, you may receive benefits depending on the nature of employment, job position, and work location. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance Coverage

The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefit programs at any time, with or without notice, consistent with applicable law.

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.
Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Applied Artificial Intelligence (AI)
jobs.description:
ABS is seeking an exceptional Software Engineer to join our Applied Artificial IntelIigence (AI) Practice Team. In this full-time role, you will design, build, and deploy intelligent systems that move beyond research into production at scale. You will focus on architecting and evaluating multi-agent systems, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and fine-tuned large language models delivering AI capabilities that drive measurable business impact.
Location:
This position can be based in Houston, Texas; Knoxville, Tennessee; or Washington, DC.
What You Will Do:
- Build at the frontier: Design and implement end-to-end AI systems, including multi-agent workflows, retrieval pipelines, and customized LLMs.
- Engineer full-stack solutions: Deliver web and backend applications that seamlessly integrate AI, ensuring reliability, scalability, and strong user experience.
- Raise the bar on evaluation: Develop rigorous truth sets, automated quality checks, and real-time monitoring pipelines to quantify performance and business outcomes.
- Prototype rapidly: Transform research concepts into production-grade systems through fast iteration, disciplined testing, and continuous refinement.
- Shape best practices: Contribute to internal standards for applied AI development, evaluation, and deployment at scale.
What You Will Need:
Education and Experienc e
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
- 5+ years of software development experience, including 3+ years building production-grade AI systems.
- Proven track record delivering AI agents, RAG pipelines, or fine-tuned models with measurable business impact.
- Experience designing evaluation frameworks and truth sets for applied AI quality assurance.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
- Strong expertise in agent frameworks and LLM orchestration (API-first development, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, etc.).
- Deep knowledge of RAG architectures, embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval optimization strategies.
- Experience with LLM fine-tuning, prompt design, and model performance evaluation.
- Full-stack engineering skills across modern web and backend technologies.
- Familiarity with MLOps practices: CI/CD, model versioning, monitoring, and deployment at scale.
- Strong grounding in applied information retrieval and vector-based systems.
Reporting Relationships:
This role reports to a project manager and does not initially include direct reports.
Salary Range:
$90,000 - $150,000
Starting salary is based on multiple factors including skillset and experience.

Notice: This role has been opened for a future need expected within three months of the original posting date of this position. Potential candidates may not receive communication until the open headcount is confirmed.

jobs.description:
Software Engineer – RL Environments (3 Open Positions)
Location:
San Francisco, CA (Onsite)
Employment Type:
Full-Time
Experience:
1–4 Years
Compensation:
$180,000–$220,000 Base + Competitive Equity + Profit Share (Total Compensation up to ~$500K)
Visa Sponsorship:
H-1B, O-1, and OPT supported
About the Role
Our client, an innovative AI startup, is hiring Software Engineers – RL Environments
to help build the training data and evaluation infrastructure used by leading frontier AI labs.
In this role, you will design datasets, evaluation frameworks, and reward signals that directly influence how next-generation AI models are trained and evaluated. You will collaborate closely with AI researchers, experiment with data collection strategies, identify model failure modes, and develop metrics that improve model performance and alignment.
Key Responsibilities
Design datasets that expose meaningful AI model failure modes across domains such as software engineering, finance, and enterprise workflows.
Build and refine evaluation rubrics and reward signals for RLHF and RLVR training pipelines.
Design and execute lightweight experiments to improve model capabilities.
Develop quantitative frameworks to measure dataset quality, diversity, and downstream impact.
Create and maintain real-world and synthetic data pipelines.
Partner with AI research teams to translate training objectives into scalable data and evaluation solutions.

Required Qualifications
1–4 years of professional Software Engineering experience.
Strong programming and problem-solving skills.
Passion for AI, reinforcement learning, and data-driven systems.
Ability to design experiments and derive actionable insights from complex datasets.
Comfortable working across multiple domains, including software engineering, finance, and enterprise applications.
Proven ability to build, ship, and iterate quickly in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with RLHF, RLVR, AI benchmarking, or AI evaluation frameworks.
Experience working with AI safety organizations or reinforcement learning environments.
Hands-on experience building real-world and synthetic data pipelines.
Startup or early-stage company experience is a plus.

Why Join?
Work on cutting-edge AI infrastructure used by leading frontier AI labs.
Highly competitive compensation package.
Equity participation and significant profit-sharing opportunities.
Visa sponsorship available (H-1B, O-1, OPT).
Opportunity to work alongside world-class AI researchers and engineers in a fast-growing startup environment.

jobs.description:
Due to the nature of the project, we require Visa independent candidates only. We are not sponsoring or transferring any work visas.
Candidate MUST be in United States and have valid work authorization.

We're looking for a product-minded Backend Software Engineer with 3+ years of experience building customer-facing software. You'll play a key role in designing, building, and scaling the core platform that powers our web, mobile, and admin applications.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-moving startup environment, enjoys owning problems end-to-end, and is comfortable making technical decisions with minimal oversight. If you've worked on AI-powered products, LLM applications, or PropTech solutions, that's a strong plus.

Required experience:

5+ years of professional experience building customer-facing software products.
Experience working in a startup or small engineering team, with significant ownership of features or systems.
Proven experience building and maintaining backend APIs for consumer-facing web and mobile applications.
Experience integrating production systems with third-party APIs and external services.
Demonstrated ability to improve, refactor, and scale existing or rapidly built codebases—not just greenfield development.
Comfortable working independently with minimal product or engineering oversight.

Technical Skills:

Strong backend development experience with Python
.
Solid understanding of REST APIs, system design, and backend architecture.
Experience with PostgreSQL
and relational database design.
Familiarity with modern frontend technologies such as TypeScript, Node.js, or React
.
Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and release automation
.
Experience using AI-assisted development tools and agentic coding workflows
to improve engineering productivity.

Nice to Have:

Experience building or integrating LLM-powered applications
or AI agents.
Exposure to PropTech
, real estate technology, or property management platforms.
Experience with cloud infrastructure, monitoring, and production operations.

What You'll Do:

Own, build, and evolve the core backend APIs powering our web, mobile, and admin platforms.
Design, develop, and enhance our LLM-powered platform, Leasa
, to deliver increasingly valuable experiences for renters and property operators.
Build scalable, performant data models that power analytics and reporting.
Improve the reliability, scalability, and observability of third-party integrations, including property management systems, CRMs, and access control platforms.
Drive engineering excellence through automated testing, CI/CD improvements, and release automation.
Collaborate closely with a small, high-performing engineering team to shape product direction, solve complex technical challenges, and ship impactful features from concept to production.
Contribute across the stack when needed, supporting frontend integrations and platform improvements.

We maintain a zero-tolerance policy toward fraudulent applications. Any candidate found to have provided false information, Misrepresented or fabricated work experience, Falsified educational credentials, Fake or altered identification documents, Fraudulent visa or work authorization documents, Impersonation or proxy interviews, will be immediately disqualified from the hiring process.
